screening_population: apparently well newborns receiving routine discharge pulse-ox screening
screening_timing_raw: routine discharge examination; early discharge via Midwife Discharge Support Programme
screening_algorithm_raw: single SpO2; >=95% normal; <95% confirmed on repeat triggered consultant neonatal-paediatric review
study_target_definition_raw: major CHD diagnosed prior to discharge; cardiac-surgery ascertainment for major CHD requiring surgery in first 12 months
diagnosis_categories_raw: source major CHD; respiratory pathology; other unspecified false-positive outcomes
diagnosis_counts_raw: major CHD4; CCHD/CHD-negative positives11, of whom respiratory pathology6 and other outcome not specified5
individual_diagnoses: four source-major-CHD lesions not individually reported in accessible primary evidence; respiratory pathology x6; five other CHD-negative screen positives without terminal diagnosis stated
lesion_mapping_status: The source's four major-CHD true positives cannot be removed automatically because lesion identities and whether a locked <=28-day death/surgery/catheterization qualifier occurred are not reported. Harmonized CCHD therefore ranges0-4 and denominator11-15. This preserves the source definition without substituting its 12-month surgery horizon for the locked target.
management_actionability_evidence: Among the 11 source-CHD-negative positives, six had respiratory pathology but no participant-specific qualifying treatment/disposition/escalation/follow-up consequence is reported -> CAN-U6; the remaining five have no terminal diagnosis/outcome reported -> UNKNOWN5. If any of the four source-major-CHD cases re-enter the harmonized-negative denominator, their structural diagnosis is clinically relevant but actionability attributable to the screening pathway is not sufficiently detailed -> CAN-U, yielding CAN-U6-10. Consultant review/diagnostic evaluation alone is not promoted to Strict.
poolability_reason: exact final-positive count15 but lesion-level harmonized-target mapping is bounded and at least5 harmonized-negative positives lack terminal diagnosis; ascertainment remains <90% under every admissible mapping
source_full_text_provenance: Bhola K, Kluckow M, Evans N. J Paediatr Child Health. 2014;50(11):920-925. PMID 24923996; DOI 10.1111/jpc.12651. Primary PubMed/Wiley report independently reverified.
extraction_notes: 18,801 screened; 4 source true-positive major CHD +11 source false-positive/no-CHD screens =15. Six of the 11 had respiratory pathology. The large-VSD false negative is outside the final-failed-screen denominator. Strict0; Expanded6-10 over denominator11-15; UNKNOWN5 fixed.

screening_population: asymptomatic newborns eligible for screening after excluding neonatal-unit admissions before screening
screening_timing_raw: early screen within 2 h and/or at NIPE around 24 h; protocol allowed repeat after2 h for 90-95%
screening_algorithm_raw: pre/postductal pulse oximetry; screen-positive newborns were admitted to neonatal unit; 90-95% could undergo medical assessment and repeat after2 h
study_target_definition_raw: critical CHD; two screen-positive CCHD cases identified
diagnosis_categories_raw: critical CHD; pneumonia; normal transitional circulation; trisomy21; TTN; congenital diaphragmatic hernia; ASD+PDA; pneumothorax
diagnosis_counts_raw: CCHD2; pneumonia10; normal transitional circulation5; trisomy21 2; TTN1; CDH1; ASD+PDA1; pneumothorax1
individual_diagnoses: infracardiac TAPVC1; TGA+VSD+ASD+CoA1; pneumonia10; normal transitional circulation5; trisomy21 2; transient tachypnoea1; congenital diaphragmatic hernia1; ASD+PDA1; pneumothorax1
lesion_mapping_status: Both source-CCHD cases satisfy the locked target independently of the deferred d-TGA policy: TAPVC underwent repair on day14; the TGA+CoA infant underwent CoA repair on day7 (and arterial switch day21). Thus harmonized CCHD=2 and denominator=21 exactly.
management_actionability_evidence: All 21 harmonized-CCHD-negative screen-positive newborns were asymptomatic before screening and were admitted to the neonatal unit because of the screen-positive result, which is an explicit acute disposition change attributable to screening -> CAN-A21. Sixteen had other clinically important diagnoses. The five classified as normal transitional circulation were likewise admitted because of the early screen; all five had blood tests and received antibiotics for at least48h. Therefore none is downgraded to NON_CAN merely because the terminal physiologic label was transitional.
poolability_reason: exact participant-level final-positive table; locked CCHD exclusions are event-qualified; every one of the21 harmonized-negative final fails has explicit screen-attributable neonatal-unit admission, giving complete actionability and diagnostic/disposition ascertainment
source_full_text_provenance: Jones AJ et al. Cardiol Young. 2016;26(7):1397-1405. PMID 26905447; DOI 10.1017/S1047951115002784. Primary PubMed/Cambridge report plus author-shared full manuscript/table independently reverified.
extraction_notes: 23 positive-screen admissions =2 locked CCHD +21 denominator. Strict21/21 and Expanded21/21. The five transitional-circulation infants are Strict because the screen caused NNU admission and >=48h antibiotics; actionability is based on observed management/disposition, not diagnostic severity. TGA policy is not invoked because the same participant independently qualifies via CoA repair day7.
